{{Top|leg}}
The '''Atrisian Order of the Nine Stars''' is an award in the [[Atrisian Commonwealth/Legends|Atrisian Commonwealth]]. The commander of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance's]] [[Taskforce Shen]], Major [[Mart Stevez]], received the award while still a junior officer in one of the Atrisian Royal Corps special mission brigades.
